name: Kevin H. Baars
occupation: Niobrara County commissioner-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Kevin H. Baars is a Niobrara County commissioner-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Elaine Griffith, who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election summary lists him with 685 votes, alongside Tiffany Thurston at 787.
